title: [Example] Card payments failing with 502 Bad Gateway
ticket: Customer reported card payments failing with 502 Bad Gateway since mid-morning. Several staff users affected in production, started after a release.
resolution: Payment processor status page showed an upstream incident. Confirmed failures in the activity log shared the same time window, paused retries, and verified with a test transaction once the processor recovered.

title: [Example] Duplicate payment receipts after session timeout
ticket: Resident paid a bill twice. Receipts show two charges a few seconds apart after the page timed out during checkout.
resolution: Matched the two transactions by timestamp, confirmed the first had completed, and refunded the duplicate. Advised the customer to wait for the confirmation page before retrying.

title: [Example] User locked out after enabling two-factor authentication
ticket: One user cannot sign in after two-factor authentication was enabled. SSO through Okta returns to the sign-in page. Chrome on Windows.
resolution: Account was flagged as unverified after an email change. Re-verified the account, reset the authenticator enrolment, and confirmed login in a private window. Other users were not affected.

title: [Example] Sync between Zendesk and Salesforce returns 401 Unauthorized
ticket: Integration stopped creating cases. API returns 401 Unauthorized since yesterday. The token was rotated last week.
resolution: The connected app still used the old token. Generated a fresh token with the same permissions, updated the integration credentials, and confirmed a new test case synced end to end.

title: [Example] Subscriber notification emails not arriving
ticket: A subscriber says notification emails stopped arriving. Other subscribers on the same list still receive them.
resolution: Subscriber had been suppressed after a bounce. Checked the sent/pending message log, confirmed the address was valid, removed the suppression and verified the next send was delivered.

title: [Example] Blank page after login in the browser
ticket: The portal shows a blank page after login for one user. Console shows failed requests. Works for colleagues.
resolution: Cleared cache and cookies, disabled a browser extension that blocked scripts, and confirmed the page rendered in a private window and after the change.
